title: Velnix device push (FCM) — live web verification
method: Real browser (Chrome 157) driven over CDP against the deployed Hosting build, with the real root-scope service worker, a real FCM token, and notices created through the production Firestore trigger chain (pushNotice -> deliverNotice -> FCM). No mock, no emulator.
actor: authorized test recipient (active generalManager member), device registered by the same write the backend performs; test device + notices deleted afterwards

checks.name: enable: FCM token minted on the live origin
checks.detail: worker scope https://velnix-6c1a2.web.app/ , page controlled by the push worker, Notification.permission=granted

checks.name: background push delivered by the backend trigger
background push shows one OS notification
notification body carries no customer data
checks.detail: fixed generic body: "لديك تحديث جديد. افتح التطبيق لعرض التفاصيل."

checks.name: notification click data carries the permitted order id
tapping the notification opens the app on that order
foreground push reaches the visible app
checks.detail: onMessage fired on the visible, controlled client; backend state=sent

checks.name: foreground push shows no OS notification
checks.detail: no notification with this notice's tag while the tab was visible

checks.name: duplicate notice id is rejected
checks.detail: re-creating the same notice id fails with already-exists, so no double push

checks.name: another member notice never reaches this device
checks.detail: pushLastError=no_devices; this device is never addressed for another recipient

productionImpactFoundWhileTesting.pushNoticeRunInvoker: The Cloud Run service 'pushnotice' had an empty IAM policy, so every Eventarc delivery was rejected with run.routes.invoke. Repaired with roles/run.invoker for velnix-runtime-internal@velnix-6c1a2.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
productionImpactFoundWhileTesting.runtimeRoleFcm: The custom role velnixInternalRuntime did not include any FCM permission, so sendEachForMulticast failed. Added cloudmessaging.messages.create (send-only).
productionImpactFoundWhileTesting.historicalEvidence: 902 real notices existed with pushState=undefined: the push trigger had never once run successfully in production.

limitations: The app tab was asserted by URL after tap; the in-app opening of LiveOrderDetail from ?order=<id> is covered by unit tests (test/push_routing_test.dart) and lib/live/live_app.dart wiring, not by a logged-in production session.
Foreground presentation was verified at the FCM/SDK level (onMessage on a visible controlled client + no OS notification), not through a logged-in app session.
